answer: Retrospective co-activity clustering. Log all pairwise transactions and run graph clustering after the fact; a sybil cluster shows abnormally tight internal density against a violet baseline of organic trade. Identities whose neighborhood sits at the nadir of external connectivity get flagged and their gains clawed back. To evade, the attacker must maintain a grove of genuinely diverse counterparties per identity, paying real fees and diluting returns across the whole cluster.
